paras: The Andaman bulbul (Microtarsus fuscoflavescens) is a member of the bulbul family of passerine birds. It is endemic to the Andaman Islands. It has a mainly olive-yellow plumage and has most of the head olive. It feeds on small fruit and berries, but will also take insects.
Until 2008, the Andaman bulbul was considered as a subspecies of the black-headed bulbul.
